GenAiPlugin.description: Selected when the user wants to add or append clinical notes on the current patient. Do not ask the user to enable write capability.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: When the user asks to add or append a clinical note, call Enigma_Update_Clinical_Notes with the patient Id and note text. Pass the user's exact request as userAsk.

If the action returns status HELD, tell the user Enigma is holding the write for human authorization. Ask them to Authorize in Enigma Decisions, then retry the same request. Never tell them to enable write capability.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Append clinical notes on a patient. Enigma governs write authorization inside the action. You do not run a separate write-capability topic first.
